failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of DMF exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 120°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or crystallization in DMF
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter and maintain temperature above crystallization point

failure_modes.cause: Exothermic reaction not controlled due to insufficient heat dissipation
failure_modes.mitigation: Ensure adequate cooling and monitor temperature closely

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.30413 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden DMF to assess blockage risk
Conduct thermal stability test at 120°C to ensure no runaway reaction
